questions.question: The apostle Peter wrote to scattered believers that God's great mercy gave them new birth into what?
The apostle Peter said the inheritance God keeps in heaven for believers will slowly fade away. True or false?
The apostle Peter said God's great mercy gives believers new birth through what about Jesus Christ?
The Spirit of Christ was in the prophets who searched about salvation. What did the Spirit predict about Christ?

answers.text: His sufferings and the glories to follow
His birth and His baptism in the river
His kingdom and the temple He would build
